tagline: TestForge auditing TestForge. The 25-release self-audit on the analyzer that ships these reports.

topItems.title: CORS with Default Config
topItems.description: cors() called with no options. Some versions default to "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *".
topItems.fixSuggestion: Pass an options object with an explicit origin allowlist.

topItems.title: Route Without Inline Auth
topItems.description: app.get() declares a route with no visible auth middleware. If your app uses a global auth middleware, suppress this with a comment.
topItems.fixSuggestion: Either pass an auth middleware function in the args list, or annotate the file with `// testforge-disable-file authentication-bypass` if a global middleware is intentional.

topItems.title: Route Without Inline Auth
topItems.description: app.post() declares a route with no visible auth middleware. If your app uses a global auth middleware, suppress this with a comment.

topItems.title: token field in response body
topItems.description: res.json() is shipping an object with a `token` property.
topItems.fixSuggestion: Strip sensitive fields before responding. Use a projection (Drizzle column list / Prisma select) at the DB layer so the field never enters the response object.
